item.title: BMW’s Smart Battery Factory Combines AI, Digital Twins and Inline Inspection
item.description: BMW incorporates AI, digital twins, and inline automated inspection at its new plant to set industry standards for high-voltage battery assembly.

item.title: Therness HeatCore AI
item.description: Therness launches HeatCore AI, combining thermal imaging and AI for real-time defect detection during manufacturing processes.

item.title: World First Combines Digital Holography with Coordinate Measuring Machines
item.description: Fraunhofer IPM introduces a multisensor system combining high-precision digital holography with a coordinate measuring machine for advanced industrial inspection.

item.title: MICRONITE Aims to Redefine the Role of CMM Metrology for Proactive Process Control
item.description: New MICRONITE software aims to transform CMM metrology into a tool for proactive manufacturing process control.

item.title: RoboCT Brings Large-Scale Computed Tomography Out of the Lab
item.description: RoboCT introduces an advanced system bringing large-scale computed tomography to industrial quality control.

item.title: Embraer and Hexagon Advance Predictive Quality for Next-Generation Aircraft Manufacturing
item.description: Embraer and Hexagon are partnering to enhance predictive quality and automation in aircraft manufacturing.

item.title: Additive Assurance Signs Distribution Agreement with NTT DATA XAM Technologies to Launch AMiRIS Real-Time Quality Assurance in Japan
item.description: Additive Assurance expands its real-time quality assurance for metal additive manufacturing into the Japanese market.
